title: Shimtech Industries acquires Fastener Technology Corp.
content: # Shimtech Industries acquires Fastener Technology Corp. Shimtech Industries is pleased to announce the acquisition of Fastener Technology Corp. The management team, led by the company president Dennis Suedkamp, will continue to operate and grow the business — now with the support of Shimtech’s additional group resources. “We are delighted to be partnering with Shimtech at this next stage of our development and look forward to providing innovative products with enhanced manufacturing capacity, while still supporting the development of our employees and the success of our customers.”. Shimtech is owned by Inflexion Private Equity and Auctus Industries. The company’s C-Class Components Division specializes in the manufacture of high-volume metallic and composite detailed components, which are complementary with FTC’s fastener products. We are excited about the complementary nature of our products and look forward to building on Mr Gulistan’s foundation as we serve our customers and take our business to the next level,”  said Brian Williams, CEO of Shimtech.
